title: Model error is paid on root MSE and the source promise is not learned by a stencil
statement: With the SAME input law/policy class and||f-fhat||L2<=tau, the surrogate compiler/predictor obeys sqrt(MSE_f)<=sqrt(R*_adaptive, f(k))+2tau. It is NOT MSE<=R*+2tau. Quadratic interpolation at0,+-e_i, e_i+e_j uses(n+1)(n+2)/2evaluations; value error nu gives tau^2<= (12n^2+5n+1)nu^2 including trace/mean error. The invisible cubic L x1(x1^2-1) vanishes at every stencil point but has Gaussian norm^2=10L^2. For arbitrary first basis/finalw, the correct predictor uses(t^Tw)z and the full compressed-Frobenius/alignment certificate; off-block errors cannot be replaced by diagonal angle residuals.32-dimensional synthetic fixture reports561 model queries,17,952 submitted coordinates,17 reads per deployment; each 8,000-deployment run pays136,000 reads / 4,352,000 dense coordinate contributions. Recorded latent/noisy MSEs are synthetic consistency checks with supplied promise/error/noise law, not acquired device guarantees or total runtime advantage. Dense sensing, prior/covariance/noise acquisition and full-input/live-evaluator comparators remain paid.

requires: Known real symmetric A, b, c and X~N(0, I), or an actually acquired whitening transform with its own costs. Exact predictable scalar linear functionals, independent policy seed and almost-sure return. Dense measurement access must physically be supplied.
For noisy fixed benchmark: independent standard Gaussian U, V, unit measurement rows and independent equal-variance Gaussian readout s; exact optimal-fixed theorem only0 < s <= 1, r <= 2m.

Same law and measurement-policy class for model transfer; actual supplied/earned L2 error, calibration and implementation certificates. Finite interpolation agreement does not identify a quadratic promise.
